test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). E sits second to the right of A. B sits fourth to the right of D. F is an immediate neighbour of E and G. Who sits third to the right of C?
solution:
Given, A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

E sits second to the right of A.

F is an immediate neighbour of E and G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35eae83cced28cd646961573160da4da3a3bebc4ee3cde57f049cf5a689a9ea5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/705e9ad17f47347561547b7e4ae6fd1434a6c4aa65615460cdee95ab61babfd9.png] 

B sits fourth
